info.title: SharpMD API
info.summary: Read and write the Markdown notes of a SharpMD account from automated flows.
info.description:
The same notes the SharpMD app shows, over plain HTTP. Authenticate with a token created in Settings > API and automations (or Settings > AI): the tokens are the ones MCP uses, so a token limited to a folder only reaches that folder, and sharing needs a token created with that permission. Notes of the team space are under @team/. Notes inside a protected folder are encrypted in the browser: they are only reachable while the person has the folder unlocked for the AI.

Every response is JSON: { "ok": true, "data": … } or { "ok": false, "error": { "code", "message" } }. Each token can make 120 requests per minute; past that the answer is 429 with a Retry-After header.

Docs with examples: https://sharpmd.app/api.html

get.summary: List the attached images and the storage in use
get.description: A token limited to a folder only sees the images that the notes of that folder use. Images of protected folders are encrypted and have no public address.

parameters.name: space
parameters.description: team for the team space. Leave it out for your own

post.description: The body is the image itself, not JSON: PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP or AVIF. The type is read from the first bytes of the file, whatever Content-Type says. The answer carries the address to put in a note, as ![](url). Anyone with that address can see the image. Uploading is part of the paid plan. Limits by default: 10 MB per image and 1 GB, 2 GB per member on a team. Errors: files_need_plan (402), bad_image (415), file_too_large and storage_full (413, with max), upload_slow (408).

parameters.name: space

markdown.description: Ready to paste into a note

post.summary: Add to a note through an inbound address
post.description: An inbound address is created in Settings > API and automations. Depending on how it was set up, what arrives is added at the end of a note, becomes a new note in a folder, or becomes a card on a board. It takes text/plain, JSON ({ "text", "title" }; any other JSON becomes a table of field and value, or a code block if it is nested), application/x-www-form-urlencoded and multipart/form-data (fields become a list; files are skipped). Up to 64 KB and 60 requests per minute. The answer never carries content of the note. GET with ?text= works only if the address allows it.

id.description: Id of the card, when the address creates cards

post.summary: What SharpMD sends to the address of an automation
post.description: One POST per event, JSON, signed. Header X-SharpMD-Signature: t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA-256 of "<t>.<raw body>" with the secret of the automation>. Reject what does not match or carries a timestamp older than five minutes. X-SharpMD-Event carries the type and X-SharpMD-Delivery the id of the event, which repeats on a retry. Answer 2xx within 8 seconds; anything else is retried up to 5 times within an hour. With the Slack or Discord format the body is { "text" } or { "content" } instead.

data.description: note.created, note.updated: rev, size, updated, and text only if the automation includes the content (up to 64 KB, with truncated). note.moved: from, to. note.deleted: trash. comment.*: comment { id, text, quote | reply }. card.*: card, board, and from/to (card.moved) or changes { key: { from, to } } (card.updated).
